"""Boundary/edge-case topologies."""
import random, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp/dev')
from harness import *

rng = random.Random(31337)
fails = 0
def T(name, fib, queries=None):
    global fails
    if queries is None:
        queries = [a for (a, l, h) in fib]
        queries += [a | 1 for (a, l, h) in fib]
        queries += [0, (1 << 128) - 1]
    ok, _ = check_fib(name, fib, queries[:400], verbose=True)
    if not ok: fails += 1

M = lambda x: x
# every single length
for L in range(0, 129):
    a = ref.mask(0xA5A5A5A5A5A5A5A5F0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0, L)
    T('len%d' % L, [(a, L, 5000 + L)])
# pairs straddling ownership boundaries
for (l1, l2) in [(16, 17), (64, 65), (0, 128), (12, 13), (58, 64), (122, 128), (5, 6), (11, 12)]:
    a = ref.mask(0x11112222333344445555666677778888, l2)
    T('pair%d-%d' % (l1, l2), [(ref.mask(a, l1), l1, 1), (a, l2, 2)])
# max-depth locals: G0 depth12 node with 5 locals (lengths 12..16) -> TYPE1 0 children
base = ref.mask(0x0000ABCD000000000000000000000000, 12)
fib = [(ref.mask(base | (i << 112), L), L, 10 * i + L) for i, L in enumerate([12, 13, 14, 15, 16])]
T('g0-depth12-locals', fib)
# G16 depth 64 leaves: 64 children of a depth-58 node, each a /64 -> TYPE3 with 61 bulk
b58 = ref.mask(0x20010db8000000000000000000000000, 58)
fib = []
for i in range(64):
    a = b58 | (i << (128 - 64))
    fib.append((ref.mask(a, 64), 64, 1000 + i))
T('g16-64-children', fib)

b124 = ref.mask(0x3000000000000000FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF, 124)
fib = [(ref.mask(b124 | i, L), L, 7 + i) for i, L in enumerate([124, 125, 126, 127, 128])]
T('g64-depth124-locals', fib)

key = [REDACTED:SECRET]
